announcements.title: Change in Jumu’ah Times from April
announcements.content:
Starting from Friday 3rd April 2026, the Jumu’ah prayer times will be as follows:

- First Khutbah starts at 1:30pm

- Second Khutbah starts at 2:30pm

Once the first prayer has finished, please leave promptly so others can attend the second prayer.

Jazakum Allahu Khayran
